rationale: The workflow already implements the applicable optimizations, and the remaining candidates are contraindicated or unsupported for this repository. (1) Dependency caching is already present via `actions/setup-node@v7` with `cache: npm`, and package-lock.json exists in the repository, so P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is contraindicated by "An equivalent cache already exists" (the Go-module cache experiment, experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9, added a cache where none existed, which is not the case here). (2) P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is contraindicated because every matrix outcome (3 OS x 3 Node versions) is required to preserve cross-platform/test coverage, and strategy.fail-fast already defaults to true in GitHub Actions, so explicitly setting it would be a no-op; the synthetic fail-fast experiments (e.g., experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-b6e04fef7ef24997) do not override the required-checks concern. (3) P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is already satisfied by the existing `concurrency` block with `cancel-in-progress: true`. (4) P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT lacks robust per-job successful-duration history (only workflow-level run timestamps are available, and macOS/Windows matrix jobs can be slower), so adding a timeout risks false timeouts on valid slow runs; the custom-timeout experiment (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) was on a different, faster lint/typecheck workflow. No supported, safe change preserves the intended build and test coverage.
